78354.subject: 🎢 Equities crash as Robinhood memes soar
78354.body:
Today’s newsletter is brought to you by **[Choose Rich Live](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**[!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)

Our very own Nick O’Neill is has launched a new stream covering crypto, finance, AI, tech, and the stories shaping the internet economy.

If you already follow Nick, you know what to expect: sharp takes, market chaos, founder brain, and the occasional banger you’ll see clipped on the timeline five minutes later.

Episodes will be streaming live on YouTube, so make sure you’re subscribed to catch the next one as it happens.

**[Subscribe to Choose Rich Live!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**

———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $77,953 (-0.5%) | **ETH** $2,453 (-0.2%) | **SOL** $102 (-1.2%)

* Robinhood chain [memes](https://x.com/Tyler_Did_It/status/2094744438887031018?s=20) continue their massive run with PONS and AI hitting new ATHs — Robinhood fully rolls out[ agentic trading ](https://x.com/RobinhoodApp/status/2094491408514077009)for crypto — Tweets [cryptic message](https://x.com/RobinhoodApp/status/2094550218918207643?s=20) with animated cat: “something new is growing”

* Brent crude surges [above $92](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2094719050609832268) after two oil tankers are struck in the Strait of Hormuz — Nasdaq 100 futures fall [over 1%](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2094725198989963506?s=20)

* Hyperliquid Labs in advanced talks to bring [perps to U.S.](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2094475125487989167) traders via Kraken parent Payward

* Japan’s 30-year yield rips above 4.18%, the [highest level](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2094701391751135533) in history

* Strategy buys another 4,603 BTC for [$369.7M](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2094395242166313299)

* SOL prints its [first green ](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2094582033003557288)monthly candle since September 2025

* Odds of a Fed rate hike this month surge to [over 66%](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2094748225383112797?s=20) on prediction markets

* Bitcoin [whales add ](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2094719678467789105)60K BTC in August while smaller wallets sell 47K BTC

* Russian[ crypto regulation](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2094644968803418197) officially goes into effect

* OpenSea launches [Solana NFTs](https://x.com/opensea/status/2094547650502631836)

* London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken to[ list tokenized equities](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2094713870439039186?s=20) on its 24-hour venue in 2027

* Crypto hacks rise 67% to 50 incidents in August with [$136.3M in losses](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2094726289282535643)

———————————————————————————


———

You are reading a plain text version of this post. For the best experience, copy and paste this link in your browser to view the post online:
https://www.dailybones.com/p/equities-crash-as-robinhood-memes-soar
